admission.justification: Spans mcp/tools/task_doc.py, mcp/tools/worktree.py, worktrees/modules/start.py, and worktrees/integration/integration_branch_authority.py, is guarded by two regression tests, and prevents typed operational refusals from surfacing as unstructured ToolError text without masking real crashes.

applicability: MCP payload builders task_doc_payload, worktree_status_payload, worktree_closeout_preview_payload, worktree_closeout_apply_payload, and worktree_checkpoint_landing_payload.
conditions: The delegated domain call raises one of the enumerated typed refusal exceptions (TaskDocError, WorktreeTargetResolutionError, ValidationError, SourceLineageRefusal, LandingCommitCheckRefusal, CommitPublicationRefusal, CloseoutQueueError, IntegrationBranchAuthorityError).
exclusions: Direct domain Python callers (which still observe the raised exceptions) and unexpected programming/environment errors such as ImportError or bare RuntimeError.
statement: MCP tool boundaries for task_doc, worktree_status, worktree_closeout_preview, worktree_closeout_apply, and worktree_checkpoint_landing convert typed domain refusals into structured ok=false payloads carrying kebab-case codes without catching ImportError or bare RuntimeError.
title: MCP payload boundaries convert narrow typed domain errors to refusals
